title: Немного терпения

beats.action: The children settle quietly beside the path, leaving the snail space to move.
They watch without reaching toward the snail.
beats.camera: medium two-shot, hands resting on knees

beats.action: Stepa notices the snail's tentacles move and quietly signals Mia to keep watching.
beats.camera: close-up on Stepa, then rack focus toward snail

beats.action: Both children remain still and curious.

safety_gates: No touching, picking up, chasing, or blocking the snail.
Keep children on the marked path and avoid implying that the animal must perform.
